This is a Go module, example.com/ledger. Make all six changes, then make sure go test ./... passes and gofmt reports nothing.

1. store.Store.Get returns (account.Acct, error) instead of (account.Acct, bool). Add an exported store.ErrNotFound and return an error that errors.Is matches to it when the id is missing. Every function that reports a missing account must now return an error that still matches store.ErrNotFound with errors.Is.
2. Rename the type account.Acct to account.Account everywhere, tests included.
3. Accounts get a currency: add a field Currency string to the account type, and give account.New a third parameter, New(id, owner, currency string). Every existing caller passes "EUR".
4. transfer.Move refuses to move money between two accounts of different currencies. It returns a new exported error transfer.ErrCurrency, which errors.Is must match, and changes neither balance.
5. A report statement prints the currency after the amount, separated by one space, for example: Ada (a1): 12.50 EUR. A frozen account still ends in " frozen" after the currency.
6. api.Service gets a method Transfer(from, to string, cents int64) error that moves the money with transfer.Move.

Keep the change to what these six steps need, and add no files except tests.
